question: Can you find 5 delivery drivers with the highest average number of daily deliveries?
sql:
WITH daily_deliveries AS (
    SELECT d.driver_id, 
           o.order_created_year, 
           o.order_created_month, 
           o.order_created_day,
           1 as delivery_count
    FROM deliveries d
    LEFT JOIN orders o ON d.delivery_order_id = o.delivery_order_id
    WHERE d.driver_id IS NOT NULL
),
driver_daily_counts AS (
    SELECT driver_id, 
           order_created_year, 
           order_created_month, 
           order_created_day,
           COUNT(*) as daily_delivery_count
    FROM daily_deliveries
    GROUP BY driver_id, order_created_year, order_created_month, order_created_day
)
SELECT driver_id, 
       CAST(SUM(daily_delivery_count) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS avg_daily_deliveries
FROM driver_daily_counts
GROUP BY driver_id
ORDER BY avg_daily_deliveries DESC
LIMIT 5
